column4: Newmont (NEM) Buys Newcrest, Creates Industry-Leading Portfolio
column10: [Newmont Corporation NEM recently announced that, following the conclusion of due diligence, it has officially entered into a binding Scheme Implementation Deed (SID). Under the SID, it will acquire 100% of the issued share capital in Newcrest under an Australian court-approved Scheme of Arrangement.Newcrest shareholders will get 0.400 Newmont shares for each Newcrest share, as well as a special dividend of up to $1.10 per share paid by Newcrest, representing a 30.4% premium. The payment of the special dividend is conditional on the scheme becoming effective. The deal, which gives Newcrest an implied enterprise value of A$28.8 billion (roughly $19.2 billion), is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2023. Shareholders of Newmont and Newcrest will own roughly 69% and 31% of the combined entity, respectively, following the scheme's implementation.The union of Newmont and Newcrest delivers an extraordinary value proposition for shareholders and other stakeholders, NEM noted. It establishes an industry-leading portfolio with a multi-decade gold and copper production profile in the most favorable mining jurisdictions in the world. The acquisition boosts Newmont's annual copper output - a critical commodity for the new energy economy - and adds almost 50 billion pounds of copper reserves and resources from Newcrest to its strong and well-balanced portfolio.This acquisition is expected to result in a world-class portfolio of assets, primarily in favorable, low-risk mining jurisdictions, with the largest concentration of Tier 1 operations. With this portfolio, Newmont will be well-placed to create strong, consistent and long-term returns while achieving best-in-class sustainability performance in the future. The portfolio is expected to deliver around 8 million ounces of combined annual gold production upon the transaction closure and combined annual copper production of approximately 350 million pounds from Australia and Canada.Newmont has identified the potential for significant synergies, with $500 million in total annual pre-tax benefits expected within the first 24 months of the transaction's completion. Pre-tax general and administrative synergies of around $100 million, generated by Newmont's scalable, integrated operating model with existing regional teams in Australia and Canada, will likely be achieved.Supply chain synergies of roughly $200 million are also expected from best-in-class pricing and existing strong partnerships with key suppliers, smelters and equipment manufacturers due to exceptional economies of scale. At least $200 million of benefits are also anticipated from Newmont's proven “Full Potential” continuous improvement program, which reduces costs and increases productivity by rapidly replicating leading processes and advanced technology.Story continuesPrice PerformanceNEM’s shares are down 28.1% over a year, underperforming the industry’s decline of 11.8%.Zacks Investment ResearchImage Source: Zacks Investment ResearchNewmont, on its first-quarter call said that it is on track to meet its attributable gold production projection of 5.7-6.3 million ounces for 2023. REFILE-UPDATE 1-Gold miner Newmont appoints Karyn Ovelmen as CFO
column10: [(Corrects spelling of CFO's name to Ovelmen throughout)May 18 (Reuters) - Gold miner Newmont Corp said on Thursday it had appointed Karyn Ovelmen, lead independent director at steelmaker ArcelorMittal, as its chief financial officer.Ovelmen will take over a position that has been vacant for nearly seven months after Baker Hughes Co tapped Newmont's Nancy Buese as its finance chief last year.The appointment also comes at a time when Newmont prepares to complete the acquisition of Australian gold miner Newcrest Mining Ltd in a deal valued at A$26.2 billion ($17.77 billion), one of the world's largest buyouts so far this year.Ovelmen will take charge during the second quarter of 2023, Newmont said in a statement."Karyn brings a breadth of global experience operating in complex financial environments," Newmont CEO Tom Palmer said.($1 = 1.4743 Australian dollars) (Reporting by Kanjyik Ghosh in Bengaluru; Editing by Vinay Dwivedi and Subhranshu Sahu)]

column4: ETFs in Focus After Mixed-Bag Gold Mining Q1 Results
column10: [Gold bullion prices surged by around 11% this year as bond yields declined and the U.S. dollar made slight gains. Expectations of a slowdown in Federal Reserve rate hikes led to this gain in gold. Risk-off trade sentiments emanating from the banking crisis also favored a gold rally this year.As a result, the first-quarter 2023 earnings of gold mining companies have become pivotal this season. Let's delve deeper to uncover the earnings and outlook for gold mining stocks as well as analyze its impact on ETFs.Earnings in FocusNewmont's (NEM) Q1 Earnings Top, Revenues Lag EstimatesIn late April, Newmont reported earnings from continuing operations of 42 cents per share in first-quarter 2023 compared with earnings of 54 cents reported in the year-ago quarter. Barring one-time items, adjusted earnings were 40 cents per share, down from 69 cents reported in the prior-year quarter but ahead of the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 33 cents.The company’s revenues for the first quarter were $2,679 million, down around 11% year over year. The figure missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $2,861.3 million. Newmont's attributable gold production in the first quarter was 1.27 million ounces, down 5% from 1.34 million ounces a year ago. Production was hurt by lower mill recovery.Newmont said that it is on track to achieve attributable gold production guidance of 5.7-6.3 million ounces. The company also expects gold CAS between $870 and $970 per ounce, and AISC within $1,150-$1,250 per ounce.Barrick Gold's (GOLD) Q1 Earnings Top Estimates, Revenues LagIn early May, Barrick Gold reported a first-quarter 2023 net income of $120 million or 7 cents per share, down from $438 million or 25 cents per share in the year-ago quarter. Barring one-time items, adjusted earnings were 14 cents per share. The figure beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 11 cents.Barrick recorded sales of $2,643 million, down around 7.4% year over year. The figure missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $3,207.6 million. The results in the reported quarter were hurt by lower year-over-year gold and copper production, a fall in gold sales volumes and higher costs. For 2023, Barrick anticipates attributable gold production in the range of 4.2-4.6 million ounces.Story continuesAgnico Eagle (AEM) Q1 Earnings & Revenues Surpass EstimatesIn early May, Agnico Eagle Mines reported a first-quarter 2023 net income of $1,816.9 million or $3.86 per share, surging from $119.1 million or 31 cents per share in the year-ago quarter. Barring one-time items, adjusted earnings were 57 cents per share. The bottom line surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of 50 cents.The company generated revenues of $1,509.7 million, up around 13.9% year over year. It surpassed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $1,300.3 million. Payable gold production was 812,813 ounces in the reported quarter, up from 660,604 ounces in the prior-year quarter. The company continues to expect payable gold production for 2023 in the range of 3.24-3.44 million ounces.Wheaton (WPM) Q1 Earnings Match Estimates, Sales MissIn early May,Wheaton Precious Metals reported adjusted earnings per share of 23 cents in first-quarter 2023, which came in line with the Zacks Consensus Estimate. The bottom line declined 34% year over year. The company generated revenues of $214 million in the reported quarter, down 30% on a year-over-year basis. The downside was caused by a 14.3% decrease in Gold Equivalent Ounces (GEOs) sold. The top line missed the Zacks Consensus Estimate of $228 million.Wheaton’s gold production was 73,037 ounces, down from the prior-year quarter’s figure of 78,054 ounces. Attributable silver production slumped 21% year over year to 4,927 ounces and palladium production declined 17% to 3,705 ounces.ETF in Focus Production worries remained prevalent in the earnings results. This was because gold prices were under pressure last year. However, scenario could improve gradually given favorable operating backdrop for gold miners. VanEck Gold Miners ETF GDX is up 17.7% this year but has lost 4.2% following downbeat-to-neutral earnings results. The afore-mentioned four companies take about 30% of the fund GDX.Newmont also have about 15% focus on iShares MSCI Global Gold Miners ETF RING and 8.5% focus on Sprott Gold Miners ETF SGDM. Barrick Gold and Agnico Eagle have about 11% and 10% exposure to SGDM, respectively. column4: Newmont (NEM) Buys Newcrest, Creates Industry-Leading Portfolio
column10: [Newmont Corporation NEM recently announced that, following the conclusion of due diligence, it has officially entered into a binding Scheme Implementation Deed (SID). Under the SID, it will acquire 100% of the issued share capital in Newcrest under an Australian court-approved Scheme of Arrangement.Newcrest shareholders will get 0.400 Newmont shares for each Newcrest share, as well as a special dividend of up to $1.10 per share paid by Newcrest, representing a 30.4% premium. The payment of the special dividend is conditional on the scheme becoming effective. The deal, which gives Newcrest an implied enterprise value of A$28.8 billion (roughly $19.2 billion), is expected to be completed in the fourth quarter of 2023. Shareholders of Newmont and Newcrest will own roughly 69% and 31% of the combined entity, respectively, following the scheme's implementation.The union of Newmont and Newcrest delivers an extraordinary value proposition for shareholders and other stakeholders, NEM noted. It establishes an industry-leading portfolio with a multi-decade gold and copper production profile in the most favorable mining jurisdictions in the world. The acquisition boosts Newmont's annual copper output - a critical commodity for the new energy economy - and adds almost 50 billion pounds of copper reserves and resources from Newcrest to its strong and well-balanced portfolio.This acquisition is expected to result in a world-class portfolio of assets, primarily in favorable, low-risk mining jurisdictions, with the largest concentration of Tier 1 operations. With this portfolio, Newmont will be well-placed to create strong, consistent and long-term returns while achieving best-in-class sustainability performance in the future. The portfolio is expected to deliver around 8 million ounces of combined annual gold production upon the transaction closure and combined annual copper production of approximately 350 million pounds from Australia and Canada.Newmont has identified the potential for significant synergies, with $500 million in total annual pre-tax benefits expected within the first 24 months of the transaction's completion. Pre-tax general and administrative synergies of around $100 million, generated by Newmont's scalable, integrated operating model with existing regional teams in Australia and Canada, will likely be achieved.Supply chain synergies of roughly $200 million are also expected from best-in-class pricing and existing strong partnerships with key suppliers, smelters and equipment manufacturers due to exceptional economies of scale. At least $200 million of benefits are also anticipated from Newmont's proven “Full Potential” continuous improvement program, which reduces costs and increases productivity by rapidly replicating leading processes and advanced technology.Story continuesPrice PerformanceNEM’s shares are down 28.1% over a year, underperforming the industry’s decline of 11.8%.Zacks Investment ResearchImage Source: Zacks Investment ResearchNewmont, on its first-quarter call said that it is on track to meet its attributable gold production projection of 5.7-6.3 million ounces for 2023. In addition, the company anticipates gold CAS between $870 and $970 per ounce and All-in sustaining cost (“AISC”) between $1,150 and $1,250 per ounce. For the second quarter of 2023, the company expects to produce around 24% of its full-year gold projection. The second half of the year is expected to deliver approximately 55% of its full-year gold production guidanceNewmont Corporation Price and ConsensusNewmont Corporation price-consensus-chart | Newmont Corporation QuoteZacks Rank & Key PicksNewmont currently carries a Zacks Rank #3 (Hold).Better-ranked stocks to consider in the basic materials space include Steel Dynamics Inc. STLD’s earnings beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate in each of the last four quarters. It has a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise of roughly 10.7% on average. STLD has rallied around 30.5% in a year.Nucor currently sports a Zacks Rank #1. NUE’s earnings beat the Zacks Consensus Estimate in each of the last four quarters. It has a trailing four-quarter earnings surprise of roughly 10.8% on average. NUE has rallied around 17.3% in a year.PPG currently sports a Zacks Rank #2. column4: Newmont Publishes 2022 Climate Report
column10: [DENVER, May 25, 2023--(BUSINESS WIRE)--Today, Newmont Corporation (NYSE: NEM, TSX: NGT) published its 2022 Climate Report, prepared in alignment with the Recommendations of the Task Force on Climate-related Financial Disclosures (TCFD). The report outlines how Newmont understands and is addressing climate change — from managing physical and transition climate risks and enhancing resiliency within our business, to climate impacts and reducing our greenhouse gas emissions.This press release features multimedia. View the full release here: https://www.businesswire.com/news/home/20230525005503/en/Newmont Corporation's 2022 Climate Report (Graphic: Business Wire)"Climate change is one of the greatest global challenges of our time and its impact on our earth and our business is undeniable," said Newmont President and CEO Tom Palmer. "We believe that industries that create value — like mining — have a responsibility to drive bold actions and innovation to facilitate the transition to a low-carbon economy."Highlights from the 2022 Climate Report include:Advancing renewable energy projects at Boddington and Tanami that have the potential to reduce emissions by up to one million tonnes of carbon dioxide equivalent;Progressing the Vision Zero program, our strategic alliance with Caterpillar, to trial zero emissions battery electric haul systems for surface and underground operations;Surveying and engaging key suppliers and customers to incorporate emission reduction targets or decarbonization commitments into contracts; andPartnering with the U.S. National Renewable Energy Laboratory on research related to carbon sequestration in mine tailings.Newmont’s Climate Report complements our recently published 2022 Sustainability Report and reinforces our commitment to provide stakeholders with a transparent and detailed look at our environmental, social and governance (ESG) performance and practices.About NewmontNewmont is the world’s leading gold company and a producer of copper, silver, zinc and lead. The Company’s world-class portfolio of assets, prospects and talent is anchored in favorable mining jurisdictions in North America, South America, Australia and Africa. Newmont is the only gold producer listed in the S&P 500 Index and is widely recognized for its principled environmental, social and governance practices. The Company is an industry leader in value creation, supported by robust safety standards, superior execution and technical expertise. Newmont was founded in 1921 and has been publicly traded since 1925.Story continuesAt Newmont, our purpose is to create value and improve lives through sustainable and responsible mining. To learn more about Newmont’s sustainability strategy and initiatives, go to www.newmont.com.Cautionary Statement: This release and the climate report contain "forward-looking statements" within the meaning of Section 27A of the Securities Act of 1933, as amended, and Section 21E of the Securities Exchange Act of 1934, as amended, which are intended to be covered by the safe harbor created by such sections and other applicable laws. column4: 3 Stellar Stocks That Are Immune to These 2023 Market Meltdowns

All major indices experienced significant declines, leaving investors shocked. It’s inevitable that every investor will experience a market crash during their lifetimes. column4: Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 Countries
column10: [This article explores Rhenium production by top 10 countries. You can skip the detailed industry analysis and jump straight to the Top 5 Countries by Rhenium Production.With an impressively high melting point, superb heat resistance, and extraordinary electrical conductivity, Rhenium finds extensive use in aerospace applications, where it is incorporated into high-temperature superalloys. This metal, with an atomic number of 72 and a relative atomic mass of 178.49, possesses remarkable properties that set it apart.Rhenium’s impressive melting point of 2233°C and boiling point of 4603°C make it highly resistant to extreme temperatures. With a density of 13310 kgm-3, Rhenium is known for its exceptional density among metals. Notably, it showcases a low electrical resistivity of 300 nΩm, combined with a high Young's modulus of 78 GPa, making it an ideal choice for applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical strength. Furthermore, Rhenium exhibits a heat capacity of 25.73 J/K/mol. Despite its relatively low natural abundance of 5.3 ppm, Rhenium stands out with its excellent thermal conductivity of 23 W/m/K.It also serves as a catalyst in various chemical reactions and plays a vital role in advanced electronics through its application in electrical contacts. Rhenium's scarcity and specialized applications contribute to its significance in the global market.Industry leaders such as BHP Group (NYSE:BBL), Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM), and Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) can shape the future of the resources sector through sustainable practices and responsible mining. BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) operates globally in mining and petroleum, while Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) practices responsible mining worldwide. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) focuses on copper, gold, and molybdenum production. With diverse portfolios, including iron ore, copper, and coal, BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) contributes to the industry. Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) invests in communities and supplies gold. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) prioritizes safety, environmental stewardship, and community engagement. By conforming to environment-friendly and ethical practices, these companies can drive positive change and inspire others in the industry to follow suit.Story continuesFrom Scarcity to Success: Global Rhenium MarketThe worldwide production of Rhenium experienced a subtle decline, as the production volume dipped to approximately 59 metric tons in 2021, which decreased from the previous level of 59.3 metric tons recorded in 2020.Rhenium continues to play a vital role in jet engines and turbine blades, as well as finding applications in catalysts for oil refining within the petrochemical sector. Moreover, the healthcare industry utilizes Rhenium in various capacities, despite its overall decrease in demand.According to the "Global Rhenium Market 2022-2026" report, the Rhenium market is projected to witness substantial growth, with its market share anticipated to grow by $80.27 million by 2026. This growth is expected to occur at a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.12% from 2021 to 2026. The market structure of the Rhenium industry is fragmented, with various players operating in the market.Technavio notes that the industry has shown a year-on-year growth of 12.38%, indicating a positive upward trend. In terms of regional analysis, the Rhenium market encompasses North America, Europe, APAC (Asia-Pacific), South America, and the Middle East and Africa. Among these regions, North America holds the largest market share, contributing approximately 65% to the overall market. Key consumer countries driving the demand for Rhenium include the United States, Canada, China, Russia, and Germany.Prominent Rhenium Market Trends To WatchAs the market for Rhenium continues to evolve, several key trends are expected to shape its trajectory. These trends include:Aerospace demand boost: Increasingly, Rhenium alloys are sought after in the aerospace and aviation sectors due to their heat resistance and mechanical strength.Energy sector advancements: Rhenium catalysts are gaining traction in fuel cells and hydrogen production, aligning with the growing demand for renewable energy technologies.Electronics integration: Rhenium's excellent electrical and thermal conductivity properties make it valuable in microelectronics and semiconductors, catering to the expanding electronics industry.Catalyst significance: Rhenium catalysts are finding wider applications in the chemical industry, particularly in petroleum refining, aromatics production, and catalytic reforming.Healthcare sector driving Rhenium-188 demand: The growing use of Rhenium-188 in the healthcare industry is set to generate promising opportunities for the Rhenium market in the foreseeable future.Rhenium-188 in nuclear medicine: Derived from the tungsten-188 generator, Rhenium-188 is a powerful radioisotope emitting high-energy radiation. It is extensively employed in nuclear medicine to produce radiopharmaceuticals used in therapeutic applications such as oncology, interventional radiology, cardiology, and other treatments.Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 CountriesPhoto by Artyom korshunov on UnsplashMethodologyOur assessment of Rhenium production among various countries involved a meticulous ranking methodology. To ensure the utmost reliability and accuracy of our findings, we extensively researched data from trusted sources such as The United States Geological Survey (USGS). By utilizing production percentages from E3S Web of Conferences, we calculated the production output of France and Germany specifically for the year 2020.  We then ranked the countries in ascending order according to their actual Rhenium production quantities, measured in metric tons. 10. ArmeniaMetric Tons: 0.26Armenia is known for its significant production of the rare metal Rhenium, especially for aerospace and defense industries utilization. The country's major Rhenium production is concentrated from the Zangezur Copper and Molybdenum Combine. Armenia's geological conditions and its abundant reserves of copper and molybdenum make it an ideal location for the production of Rhenium. The country's Rhenium production has played a vital role in boosting its economy and making it a significant player in the global metals market.9. KazakhstanMetric Tons: 1Kazakhstan's Rhenium production remained consistent at 1 metric ton in both 2015 and 2016, and this level was maintained in 2021 as well. The country implements a Rhenium recovery process that involves utilizing a sulphuric acid scrubbing solution. A noteworthy aspect of Kazakhstan's Rhenium production is the copper concentrates discovered in Zhezkazgan, which contain up to 30 grams per ton (g/t) of Rhenium.These deposits are globally recognized as the richest known sources of Rhenium. The abundance of Rhenium in these copper concentrates highlights the significant role played by Kazakhstan in meeting the demand for this valuable element, which finds applications in various industrial sectors.8. ChinaMetric Tons: 2.5Many producers in China have traditionally used the Kennecott Process for Rhenium extraction; there is an exception with Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The Kennecott Process has been widely used in the industry for over 40 years to extract Rhenium.In this process, exhaust gasses from the molybdenum roasting circuit are washed with water to produce perrhenic acid. The solution is then treated with chemicals like NaOH and Ca(ClO)2 to remove contaminants and adjust the pH. The solution undergoes ion exchange processing, where a resin adsorbs the Rhenium, which is later stripped using hydrochloric acid. The recovered Rhenium can further undergo purification steps, including recrystallization.Jiangxi Copper Corporation, which was the largest Rhenium producer in China in 2016, has developed and implemented its own production process. Their method includes solvent extraction of the scrubbing liquid, stripping of the organic solvent, purification, and crystallization of NH4ReO4, resulting in a Rhenium yield of up to 92%. Therefore, while the majority of Chinese producers employ the Kennecott Process, Jiangxi Copper Corporation has adopted a different approach to Rhenium recovery.7. Republic of KoreaMetric Tons: 2.8According to USGS, the Republic of Korea produced approximately 2.8 metric tons of Rhenium in 2020 and 2021. South Korea's production of Rhenium underscores its industrial prowess and technological advancements. The country's emphasis on innovation and research has enabled it to become a key player in the global supply chain of this valuable metal. With a focus on meeting market demands and supporting various sectors, South Korea continues to contribute significantly to the production and availability of Rhenium worldwide.6. FranceMetric Tons: 4.24In 2020, France produced approximately 4.24 tons of Rhenium. The country has emerged as one of the leading producers of Rhenium products within Western Europe. This growth can be attributed to several factors, including the expansion of the aerospace industry, a thriving automotive sector, increased applications in the biomedical field, and the utilization of Rhenium powder and salt crystals. These factors have collectively contributed to the notable increase in Rhenium production within France.Click to continue reading and see Rhenium Production by Country: Top 5 Countries.Suggested Articles:10 Best Gold Royalty Stocks to Buy Now10 Small-Cap Mining Stocks Hedge Funds Are Avoiding12 Best Silver Mining Stocks To Buy NowDisclosure: none. column4: Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 Countries
column10: [This article explores Rhenium production by top 10 countries. You can skip the detailed industry analysis and jump straight to the Top 5 Countries by Rhenium Production.With an impressively high melting point, superb heat resistance, and extraordinary electrical conductivity, Rhenium finds extensive use in aerospace applications, where it is incorporated into high-temperature superalloys. This metal, with an atomic number of 72 and a relative atomic mass of 178.49, possesses remarkable properties that set it apart.Rhenium’s impressive melting point of 2233°C and boiling point of 4603°C make it highly resistant to extreme temperatures. With a density of 13310 kgm-3, Rhenium is known for its exceptional density among metals. Notably, it showcases a low electrical resistivity of 300 nΩm, combined with a high Young's modulus of 78 GPa, making it an ideal choice for applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical strength. Furthermore, Rhenium exhibits a heat capacity of 25.73 J/K/mol. Despite its relatively low natural abundance of 5.3 ppm, Rhenium stands out with its excellent thermal conductivity of 23 W/m/K.It also serves as a catalyst in various chemical reactions and plays a vital role in advanced electronics through its application in electrical contacts. Rhenium's scarcity and specialized applications contribute to its significance in the global market.Industry leaders such as BHP Group (NYSE:BBL), Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM), and Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) can shape the future of the resources sector through sustainable practices and responsible mining. BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) operates globally in mining and petroleum, while Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) practices responsible mining worldwide. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) focuses on copper, gold, and molybdenum production. With diverse portfolios, including iron ore, copper, and coal, BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) contributes to the industry. Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) invests in communities and supplies gold. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) prioritizes safety, environmental stewardship, and community engagement. By conforming to environment-friendly and ethical practices, these companies can drive positive change and inspire others in the industry to follow suit.Story continuesFrom Scarcity to Success: Global Rhenium MarketThe worldwide production of Rhenium experienced a subtle decline, as the production volume dipped to approximately 59 metric tons in 2021, which decreased from the previous level of 59.3 metric tons recorded in 2020.Rhenium continues to play a vital role in jet engines and turbine blades, as well as finding applications in catalysts for oil refining within the petrochemical sector. Moreover, the healthcare industry utilizes Rhenium in various capacities, despite its overall decrease in demand.According to the "Global Rhenium Market 2022-2026" report, the Rhenium market is projected to witness substantial growth, with its market share anticipated to grow by $80.27 million by 2026. This growth is expected to occur at a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.12% from 2021 to 2026. The market structure of the Rhenium industry is fragmented, with various players operating in the market.Technavio notes that the industry has shown a year-on-year growth of 12.38%, indicating a positive upward trend. In terms of regional analysis, the Rhenium market encompasses North America, Europe, APAC (Asia-Pacific), South America, and the Middle East and Africa. Among these regions, North America holds the largest market share, contributing approximately 65% to the overall market. Key consumer countries driving the demand for Rhenium include the United States, Canada, China, Russia, and Germany.Prominent Rhenium Market Trends To WatchAs the market for Rhenium continues to evolve, several key trends are expected to shape its trajectory. These trends include:Aerospace demand boost: Increasingly, Rhenium alloys are sought after in the aerospace and aviation sectors due to their heat resistance and mechanical strength.Energy sector advancements: Rhenium catalysts are gaining traction in fuel cells and hydrogen production, aligning with the growing demand for renewable energy technologies.Electronics integration: Rhenium's excellent electrical and thermal conductivity properties make it valuable in microelectronics and semiconductors, catering to the expanding electronics industry.Catalyst significance: Rhenium catalysts are finding wider applications in the chemical industry, particularly in petroleum refining, aromatics production, and catalytic reforming.Healthcare sector driving Rhenium-188 demand: The growing use of Rhenium-188 in the healthcare industry is set to generate promising opportunities for the Rhenium market in the foreseeable future.Rhenium-188 in nuclear medicine: Derived from the tungsten-188 generator, Rhenium-188 is a powerful radioisotope emitting high-energy radiation. It is extensively employed in nuclear medicine to produce radiopharmaceuticals used in therapeutic applications such as oncology, interventional radiology, cardiology, and other treatments.Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 CountriesPhoto by Artyom korshunov on UnsplashMethodologyOur assessment of Rhenium production among various countries involved a meticulous ranking methodology. To ensure the utmost reliability and accuracy of our findings, we extensively researched data from trusted sources such as The United States Geological Survey (USGS). By utilizing production percentages from E3S Web of Conferences, we calculated the production output of France and Germany specifically for the year 2020.  We then ranked the countries in ascending order according to their actual Rhenium production quantities, measured in metric tons. 10. ArmeniaMetric Tons: 0.26Armenia is known for its significant production of the rare metal Rhenium, especially for aerospace and defense industries utilization. The country's major Rhenium production is concentrated from the Zangezur Copper and Molybdenum Combine. Armenia's geological conditions and its abundant reserves of copper and molybdenum make it an ideal location for the production of Rhenium. The country's Rhenium production has played a vital role in boosting its economy and making it a significant player in the global metals market.9. KazakhstanMetric Tons: 1Kazakhstan's Rhenium production remained consistent at 1 metric ton in both 2015 and 2016, and this level was maintained in 2021 as well. The country implements a Rhenium recovery process that involves utilizing a sulphuric acid scrubbing solution. A noteworthy aspect of Kazakhstan's Rhenium production is the copper concentrates discovered in Zhezkazgan, which contain up to 30 grams per ton (g/t) of Rhenium.These deposits are globally recognized as the richest known sources of Rhenium. The abundance of Rhenium in these copper concentrates highlights the significant role played by Kazakhstan in meeting the demand for this valuable element, which finds applications in various industrial sectors.8. ChinaMetric Tons: 2.5Many producers in China have traditionally used the Kennecott Process for Rhenium extraction; there is an exception with Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The Kennecott Process has been widely used in the industry for over 40 years to extract Rhenium.In this process, exhaust gasses from the molybdenum roasting circuit are washed with water to produce perrhenic acid. The solution is then treated with chemicals like NaOH and Ca(ClO)2 to remove contaminants and adjust the pH. The solution undergoes ion exchange processing, where a resin adsorbs the Rhenium, which is later stripped using hydrochloric acid. The recovered Rhenium can further undergo purification steps, including recrystallization.Jiangxi Copper Corporation, which was the largest Rhenium producer in China in 2016, has developed and implemented its own production process. Their method includes solvent extraction of the scrubbing liquid, stripping of the organic solvent, purification, and crystallization of NH4ReO4, resulting in a Rhenium yield of up to 92%. Therefore, while the majority of Chinese producers employ the Kennecott Process, Jiangxi Copper Corporation has adopted a different approach to Rhenium recovery.7. Republic of KoreaMetric Tons: 2.8According to USGS, the Republic of Korea produced approximately 2.8 metric tons of Rhenium in 2020 and 2021. South Korea's production of Rhenium underscores its industrial prowess and technological advancements. The country's emphasis on innovation and research has enabled it to become a key player in the global supply chain of this valuable metal. With a focus on meeting market demands and supporting various sectors, South Korea continues to contribute significantly to the production and availability of Rhenium worldwide.6. FranceMetric Tons: 4.24In 2020, France produced approximately 4.24 tons of Rhenium. The country has emerged as one of the leading producers of Rhenium products within Western Europe. This growth can be attributed to several factors, including the expansion of the aerospace industry, a thriving automotive sector, increased applications in the biomedical field, and the utilization of Rhenium powder and salt crystals. These factors have collectively contributed to the notable increase in Rhenium production within France.Click to continue reading and see Rhenium Production by Country: Top 5 Countries.Suggested Articles:10 Best Gold Royalty Stocks to Buy Now10 Small-Cap Mining Stocks Hedge Funds Are Avoiding12 Best Silver Mining Stocks To Buy NowDisclosure: none. column4: Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 Countries
column10: [This article explores Rhenium production by top 10 countries. You can skip the detailed industry analysis and jump straight to the Top 5 Countries by Rhenium Production.With an impressively high melting point, superb heat resistance, and extraordinary electrical conductivity, Rhenium finds extensive use in aerospace applications, where it is incorporated into high-temperature superalloys. This metal, with an atomic number of 72 and a relative atomic mass of 178.49, possesses remarkable properties that set it apart.Rhenium’s impressive melting point of 2233°C and boiling point of 4603°C make it highly resistant to extreme temperatures. With a density of 13310 kgm-3, Rhenium is known for its exceptional density among metals. Notably, it showcases a low electrical resistivity of 300 nΩm, combined with a high Young's modulus of 78 GPa, making it an ideal choice for applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical strength. Furthermore, Rhenium exhibits a heat capacity of 25.73 J/K/mol. Despite its relatively low natural abundance of 5.3 ppm, Rhenium stands out with its excellent thermal conductivity of 23 W/m/K.It also serves as a catalyst in various chemical reactions and plays a vital role in advanced electronics through its application in electrical contacts. Rhenium's scarcity and specialized applications contribute to its significance in the global market.Industry leaders such as BHP Group (NYSE:BBL), Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM), and Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) can shape the future of the resources sector through sustainable practices and responsible mining. BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) operates globally in mining and petroleum, while Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) practices responsible mining worldwide. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) focuses on copper, gold, and molybdenum production. With diverse portfolios, including iron ore, copper, and coal, BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) contributes to the industry. Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) invests in communities and supplies gold. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) prioritizes safety, environmental stewardship, and community engagement. By conforming to environment-friendly and ethical practices, these companies can drive positive change and inspire others in the industry to follow suit.Story continuesFrom Scarcity to Success: Global Rhenium MarketThe worldwide production of Rhenium experienced a subtle decline, as the production volume dipped to approximately 59 metric tons in 2021, which decreased from the previous level of 59.3 metric tons recorded in 2020.Rhenium continues to play a vital role in jet engines and turbine blades, as well as finding applications in catalysts for oil refining within the petrochemical sector. Moreover, the healthcare industry utilizes Rhenium in various capacities, despite its overall decrease in demand.According to the "Global Rhenium Market 2022-2026" report, the Rhenium market is projected to witness substantial growth, with its market share anticipated to grow by $80.27 million by 2026. This growth is expected to occur at a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.12% from 2021 to 2026. The market structure of the Rhenium industry is fragmented, with various players operating in the market.Technavio notes that the industry has shown a year-on-year growth of 12.38%, indicating a positive upward trend. In terms of regional analysis, the Rhenium market encompasses North America, Europe, APAC (Asia-Pacific), South America, and the Middle East and Africa. Among these regions, North America holds the largest market share, contributing approximately 65% to the overall market. Key consumer countries driving the demand for Rhenium include the United States, Canada, China, Russia, and Germany.Prominent Rhenium Market Trends To WatchAs the market for Rhenium continues to evolve, several key trends are expected to shape its trajectory. These trends include:Aerospace demand boost: Increasingly, Rhenium alloys are sought after in the aerospace and aviation sectors due to their heat resistance and mechanical strength.Energy sector advancements: Rhenium catalysts are gaining traction in fuel cells and hydrogen production, aligning with the growing demand for renewable energy technologies.Electronics integration: Rhenium's excellent electrical and thermal conductivity properties make it valuable in microelectronics and semiconductors, catering to the expanding electronics industry.Catalyst significance: Rhenium catalysts are finding wider applications in the chemical industry, particularly in petroleum refining, aromatics production, and catalytic reforming.Healthcare sector driving Rhenium-188 demand: The growing use of Rhenium-188 in the healthcare industry is set to generate promising opportunities for the Rhenium market in the foreseeable future.Rhenium-188 in nuclear medicine: Derived from the tungsten-188 generator, Rhenium-188 is a powerful radioisotope emitting high-energy radiation. It is extensively employed in nuclear medicine to produce radiopharmaceuticals used in therapeutic applications such as oncology, interventional radiology, cardiology, and other treatments.Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 CountriesPhoto by Artyom korshunov on UnsplashMethodologyOur assessment of Rhenium production among various countries involved a meticulous ranking methodology. To ensure the utmost reliability and accuracy of our findings, we extensively researched data from trusted sources such as The United States Geological Survey (USGS). By utilizing production percentages from E3S Web of Conferences, we calculated the production output of France and Germany specifically for the year 2020.  We then ranked the countries in ascending order according to their actual Rhenium production quantities, measured in metric tons. 10. ArmeniaMetric Tons: 0.26Armenia is known for its significant production of the rare metal Rhenium, especially for aerospace and defense industries utilization. The country's major Rhenium production is concentrated from the Zangezur Copper and Molybdenum Combine. Armenia's geological conditions and its abundant reserves of copper and molybdenum make it an ideal location for the production of Rhenium. The country's Rhenium production has played a vital role in boosting its economy and making it a significant player in the global metals market.9. KazakhstanMetric Tons: 1Kazakhstan's Rhenium production remained consistent at 1 metric ton in both 2015 and 2016, and this level was maintained in 2021 as well. The country implements a Rhenium recovery process that involves utilizing a sulphuric acid scrubbing solution. A noteworthy aspect of Kazakhstan's Rhenium production is the copper concentrates discovered in Zhezkazgan, which contain up to 30 grams per ton (g/t) of Rhenium.These deposits are globally recognized as the richest known sources of Rhenium. The abundance of Rhenium in these copper concentrates highlights the significant role played by Kazakhstan in meeting the demand for this valuable element, which finds applications in various industrial sectors.8. ChinaMetric Tons: 2.5Many producers in China have traditionally used the Kennecott Process for Rhenium extraction; there is an exception with Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The Kennecott Process has been widely used in the industry for over 40 years to extract Rhenium.In this process, exhaust gasses from the molybdenum roasting circuit are washed with water to produce perrhenic acid. The solution is then treated with chemicals like NaOH and Ca(ClO)2 to remove contaminants and adjust the pH. The solution undergoes ion exchange processing, where a resin adsorbs the Rhenium, which is later stripped using hydrochloric acid. The recovered Rhenium can further undergo purification steps, including recrystallization.Jiangxi Copper Corporation, which was the largest Rhenium producer in China in 2016, has developed and implemented its own production process. Their method includes solvent extraction of the scrubbing liquid, stripping of the organic solvent, purification, and crystallization of NH4ReO4, resulting in a Rhenium yield of up to 92%. Therefore, while the majority of Chinese producers employ the Kennecott Process, Jiangxi Copper Corporation has adopted a different approach to Rhenium recovery.7. Republic of KoreaMetric Tons: 2.8According to USGS, the Republic of Korea produced approximately 2.8 metric tons of Rhenium in 2020 and 2021. South Korea's production of Rhenium underscores its industrial prowess and technological advancements. The country's emphasis on innovation and research has enabled it to become a key player in the global supply chain of this valuable metal. With a focus on meeting market demands and supporting various sectors, South Korea continues to contribute significantly to the production and availability of Rhenium worldwide.6. FranceMetric Tons: 4.24In 2020, France produced approximately 4.24 tons of Rhenium. The country has emerged as one of the leading producers of Rhenium products within Western Europe. This growth can be attributed to several factors, including the expansion of the aerospace industry, a thriving automotive sector, increased applications in the biomedical field, and the utilization of Rhenium powder and salt crystals. These factors have collectively contributed to the notable increase in Rhenium production within France.Click to continue reading and see Rhenium Production by Country: Top 5 Countries.Suggested Articles:10 Best Gold Royalty Stocks to Buy Now10 Small-Cap Mining Stocks Hedge Funds Are Avoiding12 Best Silver Mining Stocks To Buy NowDisclosure: none. column4: An Intrinsic Calculation For Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) Suggests It's 25% Undervalued
column10: [Key InsightsNewmont's estimated fair value is US$53.88 based on 2 Stage Free Cash Flow to EquityNewmont's US$40.68 share price signals that it might be 25% undervalued The US$57.12 analyst price target for NEM is 6.0% more than our estimate of fair valueHow far off is Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) from its intrinsic value? Using the most recent financial data, we'll take a look at whether the stock is fairly priced by projecting its future cash flows and then discounting them to today's value. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model is the tool we will apply to do this. Believe it or not, it's not too difficult to follow, as you'll see from our example!We would caution that there are many ways of valuing a company and, like the DCF, each technique has advantages and disadvantages in certain scenarios. If you still have some burning questions about this type of valuation, take a look at the Simply Wall St analysis model. View our latest analysis for Newmont The CalculationWe use what is known as a 2-stage model, which simply means we have two different periods of growth rates for the company's cash flows. Generally the first stage is higher growth, and the second stage is a lower growth phase. To begin with, we have to get estimates of the next ten years of cash flows. Where possible we use analyst estimates, but when these aren't available we extrapolate the previous free cash flow (FCF) from the last estimate or reported value. We assume companies with shrinking free cash flow will slow their rate of shrinkage, and that companies with growing free cash flow will see their growth rate slow, over this period. We do this to reflect that growth tends to slow more in the early years than it does in later years.Generally we assume that a dollar today is more valuable than a dollar in the future, so we need to discount the sum of these future cash flows to arrive at a present value estimate:10-year free cash flow (FCF) estimate2023202420252026202720282029203020312032 Levered FCF ($, Millions) US$1.45bUS$1.68bUS$2.20bUS$2.98bUS$3.32bUS$3.56bUS$3.77bUS$3.95bUS$4.10bUS$4.24bGrowth Rate Estimate SourceAnalyst x12Analyst x12Analyst x9Analyst x2Analyst x1Est @ 7.43%Est @ 5.83%Est @ 4.72%Est @ 3.93%Est @ 3.39% Present Value ($, Millions) Discounted @ 9.1% US$1.3kUS$1.4kUS$1.7kUS$2.1kUS$2.1kUS$2.1kUS$2.0kUS$2.0kUS$1.9kUS$1.8k("Est" = FCF growth rate estimated by Simply Wall St)Present Value of 10-year Cash Flow (PVCF) = US$18bStory continuesThe second stage is also known as Terminal Value, this is the business's cash flow after the first stage. For a number of reasons a very conservative growth rate is used that cannot exceed that of a country's GDP growth. In this case we have used the 5-year average of the 10-year government bond yield (2.1%) to estimate future growth. In the same way as with the 10-year 'growth' period, we discount future cash flows to today's value, using a cost of equity of 9.1%.Terminal Value (TV)= FCF2032 × (1 + g) ÷ (r – g) = US$4.2b× (1 + 2.1%) ÷ (9.1%– 2.1%) = US$62bPresent Value of Terminal Value (PVTV)= TV / (1 + r)10= US$62b÷ ( 1 + 9.1%)10= US$26bThe total value, or equity value, is then the sum of the present value of the future cash flows, which in this case is US$44b. The last step is to then divide the equity value by the number of shares outstanding. Compared to the current share price of US$40.7, the company appears a touch undervalued at a 25% discount to where the stock price trades currently. The assumptions in any calculation have a big impact on the valuation, so it is better to view this as a rough estimate, not precise down to the last cent.dcfImportant AssumptionsThe calculation above is very dependent on two assumptions. The first is the discount rate and the other is the cash flows. Part of investing is coming up with your own evaluation of a company's future performance, so try the calculation yourself and check your own assumptions. The DCF also does not consider the possible cyclicality of an industry, or a company's future capital requirements, so it does not give a full picture of a company's potential performance. Given that we are looking at Newmont as potential shareholders, the cost of equity is used as the discount rate, rather than the cost of capital (or weighted average cost of capital, WACC) which accounts for debt. In this calculation we've used 9.1%, which is based on a levered beta of 1.182. Beta is a measure of a stock's volatility, compared to the market as a whole. We get our beta from the industry average beta of globally comparable companies, with an imposed limit between 0.8 and 2.0, which is a reasonable range for a stable business.SWOT Analysis for NewmontStrengthDebt is not viewed as a risk.WeaknessDividend is low compared to the top 25% of dividend payers in the Metals and Mining market.Shareholders have been diluted in the past year.OpportunityExpected to breakeven next year.Has sufficient cash runway for more than 3 years based on current free cash flows.Trading below our estimate of fair value by more than 20%.ThreatDividends are not covered by cash flow.Moving On:Whilst important, the DCF calculation shouldn't be the only metric you look at when researching a company. It's not possible to obtain a foolproof valuation with a DCF model. Instead the best use for a DCF model is to test certain assumptions and theories to see if they would lead to the company being undervalued or overvalued. If a company grows at a different rate, or if its cost of equity or risk free rate changes sharply, the output can look very different. Why is the intrinsic value higher than the current share price? This metal, with an atomic number of 72 and a relative atomic mass of 178.49, possesses remarkable properties that set it apart.Rhenium’s impressive melting point of 2233°C and boiling point of 4603°C make it highly resistant to extreme temperatures. With a density of 13310 kgm-3, Rhenium is known for its exceptional density among metals. Notably, it showcases a low electrical resistivity of 300 nΩm, combined with a high Young's modulus of 78 GPa, making it an ideal choice for applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical strength. Furthermore, Rhenium exhibits a heat capacity of 25.73 J/K/mol. Despite its relatively low natural abundance of 5.3 ppm, Rhenium stands out with its excellent thermal conductivity of 23 W/m/K.It also serves as a catalyst in various chemical reactions and plays a vital role in advanced electronics through its application in electrical contacts. Moreover, the healthcare industry utilizes Rhenium in various capacities, despite its overall decrease in demand.According to the "Global Rhenium Market 2022-2026" report, the Rhenium market is projected to witness substantial growth, with its market share anticipated to grow by $80.27 million by 2026. Key consumer countries driving the demand for Rhenium include the United States, Canada, China, Russia, and Germany.Prominent Rhenium Market Trends To WatchAs the market for Rhenium continues to evolve, several key trends are expected to shape its trajectory. These trends include:Aerospace demand boost: Increasingly, Rhenium alloys are sought after in the aerospace and aviation sectors due to their heat resistance and mechanical strength.Energy sector advancements: Rhenium catalysts are gaining traction in fuel cells and hydrogen production, aligning with the growing demand for renewable energy technologies.Electronics integration: Rhenium's excellent electrical and thermal conductivity properties make it valuable in microelectronics and semiconductors, catering to the expanding electronics industry.Catalyst significance: Rhenium catalysts are finding wider applications in the chemical industry, particularly in petroleum refining, aromatics production, and catalytic reforming.Healthcare sector driving Rhenium-188 demand: The growing use of Rhenium-188 in the healthcare industry is set to generate promising opportunities for the Rhenium market in the foreseeable future.Rhenium-188 in nuclear medicine: Derived from the tungsten-188 generator, Rhenium-188 is a powerful radioisotope emitting high-energy radiation. It is extensively employed in nuclear medicine to produce radiopharmaceuticals used in therapeutic applications such as oncology, interventional radiology, cardiology, and other treatments.Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 CountriesPhoto by Artyom korshunov on UnsplashMethodologyOur assessment of Rhenium production among various countries involved a meticulous ranking methodology. To ensure the utmost reliability and accuracy of our findings, we extensively researched data from trusted sources such as The United States Geological Survey (USGS). By utilizing production percentages from E3S Web of Conferences, we calculated the production output of France and Germany specifically for the year 2020.  We then ranked the countries in ascending order according to their actual Rhenium production quantities, measured in metric tons. 10. ArmeniaMetric Tons: 0.26Armenia is known for its significant production of the rare metal Rhenium, especially for aerospace and defense industries utilization. The country's major Rhenium production is concentrated from the Zangezur Copper and Molybdenum Combine. Armenia's geological conditions and its abundant reserves of copper and molybdenum make it an ideal location for the production of Rhenium. The country's Rhenium production has played a vital role in boosting its economy and making it a significant player in the global metals market.9. KazakhstanMetric Tons: 1Kazakhstan's Rhenium production remained consistent at 1 metric ton in both 2015 and 2016, and this level was maintained in 2021 as well. The country implements a Rhenium recovery process that involves utilizing a sulphuric acid scrubbing solution. A noteworthy aspect of Kazakhstan's Rhenium production is the copper concentrates discovered in Zhezkazgan, which contain up to 30 grams per ton (g/t) of Rhenium.These deposits are globally recognized as the richest known sources of Rhenium. The abundance of Rhenium in these copper concentrates highlights the significant role played by Kazakhstan in meeting the demand for this valuable element, which finds applications in various industrial sectors.8. ChinaMetric Tons: 2.5Many producers in China have traditionally used the Kennecott Process for Rhenium extraction; there is an exception with Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The Kennecott Process has been widely used in the industry for over 40 years to extract Rhenium.In this process, exhaust gasses from the molybdenum roasting circuit are washed with water to produce perrhenic acid. The solution is then treated with chemicals like NaOH and Ca(ClO)2 to remove contaminants and adjust the pH. The solution undergoes ion exchange processing, where a resin adsorbs the Rhenium, which is later stripped using hydrochloric acid. The recovered Rhenium can further undergo purification steps, including recrystallization.Jiangxi Copper Corporation, which was the largest Rhenium producer in China in 2016, has developed and implemented its own production process. Their method includes solvent extraction of the scrubbing liquid, stripping of the organic solvent, purification, and crystallization of NH4ReO4, resulting in a Rhenium yield of up to 92%. Therefore, while the majority of Chinese producers employ the Kennecott Process, Jiangxi Copper Corporation has adopted a different approach to Rhenium recovery.7. Republic of KoreaMetric Tons: 2.8According to USGS, the Republic of Korea produced approximately 2.8 metric tons of Rhenium in 2020 and 2021. South Korea's production of Rhenium underscores its industrial prowess and technological advancements. The country's emphasis on innovation and research has enabled it to become a key player in the global supply chain of this valuable metal. With a focus on meeting market demands and supporting various sectors, South Korea continues to contribute significantly to the production and availability of Rhenium worldwide.6. FranceMetric Tons: 4.24In 2020, France produced approximately 4.24 tons of Rhenium. The country has emerged as one of the leading producers of Rhenium products within Western Europe. This growth can be attributed to several factors, including the expansion of the aerospace industry, a thriving automotive sector, increased applications in the biomedical field, and the utilization of Rhenium powder and salt crystals. These factors have collectively contributed to the notable increase in Rhenium production within France.Click to continue reading and see Rhenium Production by Country: Top 5 Countries.Suggested Articles:10 Best Gold Royalty Stocks to Buy Now10 Small-Cap Mining Stocks Hedge Funds Are Avoiding12 Best Silver Mining Stocks To Buy NowDisclosure: none. column10: [Key InsightsNewmont's estimated fair value is US$53.88 based on 2 Stage Free Cash Flow to EquityNewmont's US$40.68 share price signals that it might be 25% undervalued The US$57.12 analyst price target for NEM is 6.0% more than our estimate of fair valueHow far off is Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) from its intrinsic value? Using the most recent financial data, we'll take a look at whether the stock is fairly priced by projecting its future cash flows and then discounting them to today's value. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model is the tool we will apply to do this. Believe it or not, it's not too difficult to follow, as you'll see from our example!We would caution that there are many ways of valuing a company and, like the DCF, each technique has advantages and disadvantages in certain scenarios. If you still have some burning questions about this type of valuation, take a look at the Simply Wall St analysis model. View our latest analysis for Newmont The CalculationWe use what is known as a 2-stage model, which simply means we have two different periods of growth rates for the company's cash flows. Generally the first stage is higher growth, and the second stage is a lower growth phase. To begin with, we have to get estimates of the next ten years of cash flows. Where possible we use analyst estimates, but when these aren't available we extrapolate the previous free cash flow (FCF) from the last estimate or reported value. We assume companies with shrinking free cash flow will slow their rate of shrinkage, and that companies with growing free cash flow will see their growth rate slow, over this period. We do this to reflect that growth tends to slow more in the early years than it does in later years.Generally we assume that a dollar today is more valuable than a dollar in the future, so we need to discount the sum of these future cash flows to arrive at a present value estimate:10-year free cash flow (FCF) estimate2023202420252026202720282029203020312032 Levered FCF ($, Millions) US$1.45bUS$1.68bUS$2.20bUS$2.98bUS$3.32bUS$3.56bUS$3.77bUS$3.95bUS$4.10bUS$4.24bGrowth Rate Estimate SourceAnalyst x12Analyst x12Analyst x9Analyst x2Analyst x1Est @ 7.43%Est @ 5.83%Est @ 4.72%Est @ 3.93%Est @ 3.39% Present Value ($, Millions) Discounted @ 9.1% US$1.3kUS$1.4kUS$1.7kUS$2.1kUS$2.1kUS$2.1kUS$2.0kUS$2.0kUS$1.9kUS$1.8k("Est" = FCF growth rate estimated by Simply Wall St)Present Value of 10-year Cash Flow (PVCF) = US$18bStory continuesThe second stage is also known as Terminal Value, this is the business's cash flow after the first stage. For a number of reasons a very conservative growth rate is used that cannot exceed that of a country's GDP growth. In this case we have used the 5-year average of the 10-year government bond yield (2.1%) to estimate future growth. In the same way as with the 10-year 'growth' period, we discount future cash flows to today's value, using a cost of equity of 9.1%.Terminal Value (TV)= FCF2032 × (1 + g) ÷ (r – g) = US$4.2b× (1 + 2.1%) ÷ (9.1%– 2.1%) = US$62bPresent Value of Terminal Value (PVTV)= TV / (1 + r)10= US$62b÷ ( 1 + 9.1%)10= US$26bThe total value, or equity value, is then the sum of the present value of the future cash flows, which in this case is US$44b. The last step is to then divide the equity value by the number of shares outstanding. Compared to the current share price of US$40.7, the company appears a touch undervalued at a 25% discount to where the stock price trades currently. The assumptions in any calculation have a big impact on the valuation, so it is better to view this as a rough estimate, not precise down to the last cent.dcfImportant AssumptionsThe calculation above is very dependent on two assumptions. The first is the discount rate and the other is the cash flows. Part of investing is coming up with your own evaluation of a company's future performance, so try the calculation yourself and check your own assumptions. The DCF also does not consider the possible cyclicality of an industry, or a company's future capital requirements, so it does not give a full picture of a company's potential performance. Given that we are looking at Newmont as potential shareholders, the cost of equity is used as the discount rate, rather than the cost of capital (or weighted average cost of capital, WACC) which accounts for debt. In this calculation we've used 9.1%, which is based on a levered beta of 1.182. Beta is a measure of a stock's volatility, compared to the market as a whole. We get our beta from the industry average beta of globally comparable companies, with an imposed limit between 0.8 and 2.0, which is a reasonable range for a stable business.SWOT Analysis for NewmontStrengthDebt is not viewed as a risk.WeaknessDividend is low compared to the top 25% of dividend payers in the Metals and Mining market.Shareholders have been diluted in the past year.OpportunityExpected to breakeven next year.Has sufficient cash runway for more than 3 years based on current free cash flows.Trading below our estimate of fair value by more than 20%.ThreatDividends are not covered by cash flow.Moving On:Whilst important, the DCF calculation shouldn't be the only metric you look at when researching a company. It's not possible to obtain a foolproof valuation with a DCF model. Instead the best use for a DCF model is to test certain assumptions and theories to see if they would lead to the company being undervalued or overvalued. column4: Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 Countries
column10: [This article explores Rhenium production by top 10 countries. You can skip the detailed industry analysis and jump straight to the Top 5 Countries by Rhenium Production.With an impressively high melting point, superb heat resistance, and extraordinary electrical conductivity, Rhenium finds extensive use in aerospace applications, where it is incorporated into high-temperature superalloys. This metal, with an atomic number of 72 and a relative atomic mass of 178.49, possesses remarkable properties that set it apart.Rhenium’s impressive melting point of 2233°C and boiling point of 4603°C make it highly resistant to extreme temperatures. With a density of 13310 kgm-3, Rhenium is known for its exceptional density among metals. Notably, it showcases a low electrical resistivity of 300 nΩm, combined with a high Young's modulus of 78 GPa, making it an ideal choice for applications requiring both electrical conductivity and mechanical strength. Furthermore, Rhenium exhibits a heat capacity of 25.73 J/K/mol. Despite its relatively low natural abundance of 5.3 ppm, Rhenium stands out with its excellent thermal conductivity of 23 W/m/K.It also serves as a catalyst in various chemical reactions and plays a vital role in advanced electronics through its application in electrical contacts. Rhenium's scarcity and specialized applications contribute to its significance in the global market.Industry leaders such as BHP Group (NYSE:BBL), Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM), and Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) can shape the future of the resources sector through sustainable practices and responsible mining. BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) operates globally in mining and petroleum, while Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) practices responsible mining worldwide. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) focuses on copper, gold, and molybdenum production. With diverse portfolios, including iron ore, copper, and coal, BHP Group (NYSE:BBL) contributes to the industry. Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) invests in communities and supplies gold. Freeport-McMoRan Inc. (NYSE:FCX) prioritizes safety, environmental stewardship, and community engagement. By conforming to environment-friendly and ethical practices, these companies can drive positive change and inspire others in the industry to follow suit.Story continuesFrom Scarcity to Success: Global Rhenium MarketThe worldwide production of Rhenium experienced a subtle decline, as the production volume dipped to approximately 59 metric tons in 2021, which decreased from the previous level of 59.3 metric tons recorded in 2020.Rhenium continues to play a vital role in jet engines and turbine blades, as well as finding applications in catalysts for oil refining within the petrochemical sector. Moreover, the healthcare industry utilizes Rhenium in various capacities, despite its overall decrease in demand.According to the "Global Rhenium Market 2022-2026" report, the Rhenium market is projected to witness substantial growth, with its market share anticipated to grow by $80.27 million by 2026. This growth is expected to occur at a compounded annual growth rate (CAGR) of 10.12% from 2021 to 2026. The market structure of the Rhenium industry is fragmented, with various players operating in the market.Technavio notes that the industry has shown a year-on-year growth of 12.38%, indicating a positive upward trend. In terms of regional analysis, the Rhenium market encompasses North America, Europe, APAC (Asia-Pacific), South America, and the Middle East and Africa. Among these regions, North America holds the largest market share, contributing approximately 65% to the overall market. Key consumer countries driving the demand for Rhenium include the United States, Canada, China, Russia, and Germany.Prominent Rhenium Market Trends To WatchAs the market for Rhenium continues to evolve, several key trends are expected to shape its trajectory. These trends include:Aerospace demand boost: Increasingly, Rhenium alloys are sought after in the aerospace and aviation sectors due to their heat resistance and mechanical strength.Energy sector advancements: Rhenium catalysts are gaining traction in fuel cells and hydrogen production, aligning with the growing demand for renewable energy technologies.Electronics integration: Rhenium's excellent electrical and thermal conductivity properties make it valuable in microelectronics and semiconductors, catering to the expanding electronics industry.Catalyst significance: Rhenium catalysts are finding wider applications in the chemical industry, particularly in petroleum refining, aromatics production, and catalytic reforming.Healthcare sector driving Rhenium-188 demand: The growing use of Rhenium-188 in the healthcare industry is set to generate promising opportunities for the Rhenium market in the foreseeable future.Rhenium-188 in nuclear medicine: Derived from the tungsten-188 generator, Rhenium-188 is a powerful radioisotope emitting high-energy radiation. It is extensively employed in nuclear medicine to produce radiopharmaceuticals used in therapeutic applications such as oncology, interventional radiology, cardiology, and other treatments.Rhenium Production by Country: Top 10 CountriesPhoto by Artyom korshunov on UnsplashMethodologyOur assessment of Rhenium production among various countries involved a meticulous ranking methodology. To ensure the utmost reliability and accuracy of our findings, we extensively researched data from trusted sources such as The United States Geological Survey (USGS). By utilizing production percentages from E3S Web of Conferences, we calculated the production output of France and Germany specifically for the year 2020.  We then ranked the countries in ascending order according to their actual Rhenium production quantities, measured in metric tons. 10. ArmeniaMetric Tons: 0.26Armenia is known for its significant production of the rare metal Rhenium, especially for aerospace and defense industries utilization. The country's major Rhenium production is concentrated from the Zangezur Copper and Molybdenum Combine. Armenia's geological conditions and its abundant reserves of copper and molybdenum make it an ideal location for the production of Rhenium. The country's Rhenium production has played a vital role in boosting its economy and making it a significant player in the global metals market.9. KazakhstanMetric Tons: 1Kazakhstan's Rhenium production remained consistent at 1 metric ton in both 2015 and 2016, and this level was maintained in 2021 as well. The country implements a Rhenium recovery process that involves utilizing a sulphuric acid scrubbing solution. A noteworthy aspect of Kazakhstan's Rhenium production is the copper concentrates discovered in Zhezkazgan, which contain up to 30 grams per ton (g/t) of Rhenium.These deposits are globally recognized as the richest known sources of Rhenium. The abundance of Rhenium in these copper concentrates highlights the significant role played by Kazakhstan in meeting the demand for this valuable element, which finds applications in various industrial sectors.8. ChinaMetric Tons: 2.5Many producers in China have traditionally used the Kennecott Process for Rhenium extraction; there is an exception with Jiangxi Copper Corporation. The Kennecott Process has been widely used in the industry for over 40 years to extract Rhenium.In this process, exhaust gasses from the molybdenum roasting circuit are washed with water to produce perrhenic acid. The solution is then treated with chemicals like NaOH and Ca(ClO)2 to remove contaminants and adjust the pH. The solution undergoes ion exchange processing, where a resin adsorbs the Rhenium, which is later stripped using hydrochloric acid. The recovered Rhenium can further undergo purification steps, including recrystallization.Jiangxi Copper Corporation, which was the largest Rhenium producer in China in 2016, has developed and implemented its own production process. Their method includes solvent extraction of the scrubbing liquid, stripping of the organic solvent, purification, and crystallization of NH4ReO4, resulting in a Rhenium yield of up to 92%. Therefore, while the majority of Chinese producers employ the Kennecott Process, Jiangxi Copper Corporation has adopted a different approach to Rhenium recovery.7. Republic of KoreaMetric Tons: 2.8According to USGS, the Republic of Korea produced approximately 2.8 metric tons of Rhenium in 2020 and 2021. South Korea's production of Rhenium underscores its industrial prowess and technological advancements. The country's emphasis on innovation and research has enabled it to become a key player in the global supply chain of this valuable metal. With a focus on meeting market demands and supporting various sectors, South Korea continues to contribute significantly to the production and availability of Rhenium worldwide.6. FranceMetric Tons: 4.24In 2020, France produced approximately 4.24 tons of Rhenium. The country has emerged as one of the leading producers of Rhenium products within Western Europe. This growth can be attributed to several factors, including the expansion of the aerospace industry, a thriving automotive sector, increased applications in the biomedical field, and the utilization of Rhenium powder and salt crystals. These factors have collectively contributed to the notable increase in Rhenium production within France.Click to continue reading and see Rhenium Production by Country: Top 5 Countries.Suggested Articles:10 Best Gold Royalty Stocks to Buy Now10 Small-Cap Mining Stocks Hedge Funds Are Avoiding12 Best Silver Mining Stocks To Buy NowDisclosure: none. column4: An Intrinsic Calculation For Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) Suggests It's 25% Undervalued
column10: [Key InsightsNewmont's estimated fair value is US$53.88 based on 2 Stage Free Cash Flow to EquityNewmont's US$40.68 share price signals that it might be 25% undervalued The US$57.12 analyst price target for NEM is 6.0% more than our estimate of fair valueHow far off is Newmont Corporation (NYSE:NEM) from its intrinsic value? Using the most recent financial data, we'll take a look at whether the stock is fairly priced by projecting its future cash flows and then discounting them to today's value. The Discounted Cash Flow (DCF) model is the tool we will apply to do this. Believe it or not, it's not too difficult to follow, as you'll see from our example!We would caution that there are many ways of valuing a company and, like the DCF, each technique has advantages and disadvantages in certain scenarios. If you still have some burning questions about this type of valuation, take a look at the Simply Wall St analysis model. View our latest analysis for Newmont The CalculationWe use what is known as a 2-stage model, which simply means we have two different periods of growth rates for the company's cash flows. Generally the first stage is higher growth, and the second stage is a lower growth phase. To begin with, we have to get estimates of the next ten years of cash flows. Where possible we use analyst estimates, but when these aren't available we extrapolate the previous free cash flow (FCF) from the last estimate or reported value. We assume companies with shrinking free cash flow will slow their rate of shrinkage, and that companies with growing free cash flow will see their growth rate slow, over this period. We do this to reflect that growth tends to slow more in the early years than it does in later years.Generally we assume that a dollar today is more valuable than a dollar in the future, so we need to discount the sum of these future cash flows to arrive at a present value estimate:10-year free cash flow (FCF) estimate2023202420252026202720282029203020312032 Levered FCF ($, Millions) US$1.45bUS$1.68bUS$2.20bUS$2.98bUS$3.32bUS$3.56bUS$3.77bUS$3.95bUS$4.10bUS$4.24bGrowth Rate Estimate SourceAnalyst x12Analyst x12Analyst x9Analyst x2Analyst x1Est @ 7.43%Est @ 5.83%Est @ 4.72%Est @ 3.93%Est @ 3.39% Present Value ($, Millions) Discounted @ 9.1% US$1.3kUS$1.4kUS$1.7kUS$2.1kUS$2.1kUS$2.1kUS$2.0kUS$2.0kUS$1.9kUS$1.8k("Est" = FCF growth rate estimated by Simply Wall St)Present Value of 10-year Cash Flow (PVCF) = US$18bStory continuesThe second stage is also known as Terminal Value, this is the business's cash flow after the first stage. For a number of reasons a very conservative growth rate is used that cannot exceed that of a country's GDP growth. In this case we have used the 5-year average of the 10-year government bond yield (2.1%) to estimate future growth. In the same way as with the 10-year 'growth' period, we discount future cash flows to today's value, using a cost of equity of 9.1%.Terminal Value (TV)= FCF2032 × (1 + g) ÷ (r – g) = US$4.2b× (1 + 2.1%) ÷ (9.1%– 2.1%) = US$62bPresent Value of Terminal Value (PVTV)= TV / (1 + r)10= US$62b÷ ( 1 + 9.1%)10= US$26bThe total value, or equity value, is then the sum of the present value of the future cash flows, which in this case is US$44b. The last step is to then divide the equity value by the number of shares outstanding. Compared to the current share price of US$40.7, the company appears a touch undervalued at a 25% discount to where the stock price trades currently. The assumptions in any calculation have a big impact on the valuation, so it is better to view this as a rough estimate, not precise down to the last cent.dcfImportant AssumptionsThe calculation above is very dependent on two assumptions. The first is the discount rate and the other is the cash flows. Part of investing is coming up with your own evaluation of a company's future performance, so try the calculation yourself and check your own assumptions. The DCF also does not consider the possible cyclicality of an industry, or a company's future capital requirements, so it does not give a full picture of a company's potential performance. Given that we are looking at Newmont as potential shareholders, the cost of equity is used as the discount rate, rather than the cost of capital (or weighted average cost of capital, WACC) which accounts for debt. In this calculation we've used 9.1%, which is based on a levered beta of 1.182. Beta is a measure of a stock's volatility, compared to the market as a whole. We get our beta from the industry average beta of globally comparable companies, with an imposed limit between 0.8 and 2.0, which is a reasonable range for a stable business.SWOT Analysis for NewmontStrengthDebt is not viewed as a risk.WeaknessDividend is low compared to the top 25% of dividend payers in the Metals and Mining market.Shareholders have been diluted in the past year.OpportunityExpected to breakeven next year.Has sufficient cash runway for more than 3 years based on current free cash flows.Trading below our estimate of fair value by more than 20%.ThreatDividends are not covered by cash flow.Moving On:Whilst important, the DCF calculation shouldn't be the only metric you look at when researching a company. It's not possible to obtain a foolproof valuation with a DCF model. Instead the best use for a DCF model is to test certain assumptions and theories to see if they would lead to the company being undervalued or overvalued. If a company grows at a different rate, or if its cost of equity or risk free rate changes sharply, the output can look very different. Why is the intrinsic value higher than the current share price?
